evidence_requirement: Peak observed simultaneity per substrate over a simulated 2048-unit schedule, sampled at 1Hz, against the configured ceiling.

implementation.readout: LiveReadout.peak is max(sample.live); ConcurrencyGovernor.live_counts is len(_running). can_admit reads ceilings; readout does not.

negative_controls.description: Ceilings of 10^6 admit the whole per-substrate cohort at t=0; measured peaks equal cohort size and exceed the real ceilings.
fixtures/derived_readout_mutant.py returns self.ceilings from peak/peaks/live_counts; AST auditor FIRES readout-derived-from-config. Honest LiveReadout is silent.
After a run, assigning 9999 into result.ceilings leaves readout.peaks() unchanged. Raising the ceiling before a re-run increases the measured peak.
